# Sirach Chapter 8 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 8 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_008_page_001.jpg

---

**1** Don't pick a fight with someone powerful — you'll end up in their grip.

**2** Don't argue with someone rich — they'll just outweigh you. Gold has destroyed many people and led kings astray.

**3** Don't get into a war of words with someone who never shuts up. Don't throw fuel on that fire.

**4** Don't mock or joke with uneducated people — they'll end up insulting your family.

**5** Don't rub it in when someone is turning away from sin. We all have our own guilt to answer for.

**6** Don't despise an old person. We're all heading there ourselves.

**7** Don't gloat when someone dies. We all have to die eventually.

**8** Don't neglect what wise people have to say. Spend time with their sayings — they will teach you discipline and show you how to conduct yourself before people of importance.

**9** Don't dismiss what the elders teach. They learned from their own parents, and from them you can learn discernment — and how to speak well when you need to.

**10** Don't fan the flames around a sinner. You'll get burned.

**11** Don't rise to confront someone who is shameless. They'll lay a trap using your own words.

**12** Don't lend to someone more powerful than you. If you do, just write it off.

**13** Don't promise more as a guarantor than you can actually cover. If you do guarantee something, be ready to pay up.

**14** Don't take someone to court if they're a judge. The decision will go their way.

**15** Don't travel with a reckless person. They'll become a burden. They do whatever they feel like, and you could go down with them because of their foolishness.

**16** Don't start a fight with a hot-head. Don't journey through desolate country with one either. To them, killing is nothing — and in a place with no witnesses, you could be the victim.

**17** Don't share your secrets with a fool. Whatever you tell them will get out.

**18** Don't do anything private in front of a stranger — you have no idea what they'll be saying about it later.

**19** Don't open yourself up completely to just anyone. And don't do favors for someone who won't appreciate them.
